title: Screaming Tree Vortex
description: A surreal painting featuring a dark leafless tree with orange and blue flames or leaves swirling in a vortex around a large central blue face with wide terrified eyes and an open screaming mouth. Blue rays emanate from the face's right eye toward a swirling orange spiral on the right.
